# LaZer 3330e48 (upstream), vendored

- Source: <https://github.com/lazer-crypto/lazer>, commit `3330e487228f633eceb322807b13a596b516770f` (2026-09-28); the
  upstream commit the `pqz-core` fork (`pqz-core/pqzl/lazer/`, ours, tracked) started from and every golden KAT
  `pqz-core/params/sets/<set>/lazer-3330e48-kat.json` was dumped from.
- License: MIT (`LICENSE`, Copyright (c) 2022-2026 IBM); its `third_party/` zips (Intel HEXL, Falcon) carry their own.
- Fetched (TODO 8b-9 (4b), [ARCH-POS-24](../docs/decisions.md#ARCH-POS-24); group `kat`): `scripts/vendor.sh install
  kat` runs `git fetch --depth 1` of that commit id alone (git checks every object against it) and checks it out in a
  fresh temporary directory, then moves it to `vendor/lazer-3330e48/`; the one-commit `.git` stays, so `git -C <dir>
  rev-parse HEAD` and a local `git clone` of the directory work. Nothing is edited.
- Pins (in `scripts/vendor.sh`; `install` and `check` require all three): the commit; sha256
  `d84efa27e9da25602dc844e561582c37e79c8c25405350fc3842e8a5dff02d4a` over `sha256sum` of every file but `.git`, sorted
  by path; git tree id `930143bfdf00172100a2c6ca8a0df4f6e7e7d2d2` (`git write-tree` over the same files).
- The commit's own tree is `341154e144a7c681571590fc3ac38a3ab944e0a8`; it differs from the installed tree only by the
  submodule link `src/labrados`, not fetched (the KAT and cross-check builds never used it; the clones they ran from had
  it empty). The installed tree equals the clone the parameter-set runs used (`PQZ_TOOLS/lz`).
- Use: built only by scripts on the owner's machine (docker), never by CI or `pqz-core/gate.sh`:
  `pqzl/kat/build-lazer-dump.sh` (the golden KAT, through `params/sets/make.sh <set> kat`), `artifact/reproduce.sh
  --upstream`, `research/upstream/build-upstream.sh` and `static/build.sh`; each clones this directory and builds in the
  clone, never here. `make.sh`'s `codegen` / `e_s1` and the `pqzl/params` scripts mount its `third_party/` read-only.
- Status: **UNAUDITED** (third-party; no SCaaS audit round covers it).
